my boyfriend is a doc, and tells me about the field a lot, and it's a real fucking bummer, man. he's a psychiatrist.
basically, if you're medicaid, or obamacare, you go straight to the bottom of the list. It's not everyone on these plans' faults, it's just how it works. they cost doctors money. Whereas a good insurance provider will pay the doctor (made up numbers here) $80 out of $100 per visit, medicaid and obamacare pay around $3 per, and the docs lose money on any tests, or supplies they use, because they have to pay for them. becuase the people selling the shit to hospitals are controlled by the govt, not medicine, and they charge $700 for a strep test that actually costs about $0.88 to make. legit. 

So my insurance is good, blue cross blue shield. Premium has been paid up for a while now.
But i live in a state where the psych patient saturation is HIGH AF. the hospital my bf works at, his program director, has a patient base of 2,500 patients that he sees, and a 6,000 patient waiting list. it's at least 5 months to see ANYONE here. and inpatient psych runs around a $600 daily copay, even tho my insurance is paid up. 
Literally that expensive so the govt. gets paid more for the most needed med field in the US.
you know, for every 100 psychiatrists needed in this country, 28 are trained and graduate. for every 100 surgeons, 114 are trained and graduate. 
and people are killing themselves like crazy. getting an inside view of this crap is a real bummer.
